facts.fact: Commissioner Madhub says Mauritius adopted a new data protection regime in 2017, after a first law in 2004 partly implemented in 2009, and describes it as the country's current law.
Madhub says the office can register controllers and processors, make them fill in forms, and do some enquiries and fine them, giving no count or named decision.
Drudeisha Madhub is named as the Data Protection Commissioner of Mauritius.
